subject: Re: Kickoff: KeyPose for transparent-object bin picking
body:
Lucia,

Resourcing and the data-platform picture you asked for.

Staffing: Yara 60% on modeling, Leilani 50% on the stereo capture rig integration, Wanjiru 50% on the Corpus ingest pipeline, Rosa 40% on eval tooling. Compute is light — TF2 training for these models fits on 8 Titan A100s best-effort; no Vulcan reservation needed.

On the Corpus dependency: Wanjiru synced with the platform side on the v2 migration timeline. Corpus v2 migration freeze is 2026-07-24, so if we land our re-ingest by Jul 17 we're a clean week ahead of the freeze. Plan is: pilot captures ingested to v2 schema directly (skip v1 entirely), registered stereo pairs plus depth, camera parameters as sidecar metadata exactly like the public release format.

One watch item: the released labels assume pixel-registered RGB/depth; our lab rig needs a calibration pass before that holds.

Ivo
